Q5731.reason: The brother's interest follows the son's life estate and takes effect only if the uncle moves, so it is a contingent remainder pur autre vie.

Q5115.reason: Lactate production rises when glycolysis is activated at the onset of exercise, because pyruvate is made faster than it is oxidized. A falling pH is a consequence of lactate production, not its trigger.

Q5932.reason: Intermittent high-intensity exercise raises catecholamines and hepatic glucose output, so blood glucose often rises by 1-3 mM rather than falling.
